exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Ordering a Healthy Lunch
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: I'm starving. Should we just get some pizza and soda?
Leo: Let's try something healthier today. I'm taking charge of my diet.
Mia: Really? What are you going to order, then?
Leo: A salad with lots of colourful vegetables and some grilled chicken.
Mia: That does sound good. But I really want a soda.
Leo: Sugary drinks just add extra calories. Why not have water instead?
Mia: You're right. I'll have water and a fruit bowl.
Leo: Great choice. Half our plates are fruits and vegetables now!
exercises.translation_cn: Mia 饿了想点披萨和汽水;Leo 想吃更健康的,正在掌管自己的饮食;他打算点彩色蔬菜沙拉和烤鸡;Mia 想喝汽水;Leo 说含糖饮料只是多余热量,建议喝水;Mia 改点水和水果;两人盘子一半是水果蔬菜。

questions.stem: What does Mia first want to order?
Why is Leo choosing healthier food today?
options: He is taking charge of his diet.

questions.stem: What does Leo say about sugary drinks?
What does Mia decide to drink in the end?
What do their plates mostly contain by the end?

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Secrets of Super-agers
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Scientists are interested in people who stay healthy at a very old age.
These super-agers often share a few simple habits.
They eat a plant-based diet and rarely eat until they are full.
They also get gentle exercise every single day.
Most importantly, they keep close friends to share their lives with.
exercises.translation_cn: 科学家对高龄仍健康的人很感兴趣;这些'超级老人'常有几个简单习惯;他们吃植物性饮食、很少吃到饱;每天都做轻柔运动;最重要的是,他们有亲密的朋友相伴。

questions.stem: Who are scientists interested in?
options: People who stay healthy at a very old age.

questions.stem: What kind of diet do super-agers eat?
How much do they usually eat?
options: They always eat until very full.
They rarely eat until they are full.
They eat only once a week.

questions.stem: How often do they get gentle exercise?
What does the passage say is most important?
options: Keeping close friends to share life with.

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Let's Exercise Together
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Anna: You look tired, Sam. Are you sleeping enough?
Sam: Not really. And I never seem to have energy after class.
Anna: Have you tried exercising? It actually builds energy instead of using it up.
Sam: But I'm too tired to start.
Anna: Then come jogging with me. It's more fun with a friend.
Sam: All right. Where should we go?
Anna: There's a quiet park nearby. Let's stretch first, then run slowly.
Sam: Sounds good. Maybe we can sign up for the charity run too.
exercises.translation_cn: Anna 见 Sam 疲惫,问他睡得够不够;Sam 课后总没精力;Anna 说运动其实能增加而非消耗精力;Sam 太累不想开始;Anna 邀他一起慢跑,有朋友更有趣;两人决定去附近安静的公园,先拉伸再慢跑;还打算报名慈善跑。

questions.stem: What problem does Sam have?
options: He has no energy after class.

questions.stem: What does Anna say about exercise?
options: It uses up all your energy.
It is bad for tired people.

questions.stem: Why does Anna suggest jogging together?
options: It is more fun with a friend.

questions.stem: What does Anna want to do before running?
What might they sign up for?

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 A Tip for Better Sleep
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Getting enough sleep is one of the easiest ways to stay healthy.
If you do not sleep enough, you may feel moody and easily annoyed.
Teenagers should try to get eight to ten hours each night.
A simple tip is to keep your phone in another room.
Stay motivated, and an early bedtime will soon become a habit.
exercises.translation_cn: 充足睡眠是保持健康最简单的方法之一;睡不够会让人情绪低落、易怒;青少年每晚应睡八到十小时;一个简单贴士是把手机放在别的房间;保持动力,早睡很快会成为习惯。

questions.stem: What is one of the easiest ways to stay healthy?
How might you feel without enough sleep?
How many hours should teenagers sleep each night?
What simple tip does the passage give?
options: Keep your phone in another room.

questions.stem: What will help an early bedtime become a habit?

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 At the Dentist
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Dentist: How long do you usually spend brushing your teeth?
Ben: Maybe thirty seconds? I'm always in a hurry.
Dentist: That's far too short. Proper brushing takes at least two minutes.
Ben: Two minutes? I never realised it should be that long.
Dentist: An electric brush with a timer could really help you.
Ben: Does it clean better than an ordinary one?
Dentist: Studies confirm it removes more of the soft film on your teeth.
Ben: Then I'll get one. I want to protect my overall health.
exercises.translation_cn: 牙医问 Ben 平时刷牙多久;Ben 说大概三十秒,总是匆忙;牙医说太短,正确刷牙至少两分钟;Ben 没意识到要这么久;牙医建议用带计时器的电动牙刷;问能否刷得更干净;牙医说研究证实它能去除更多牙齿软膜;Ben 决定买一支,保护整体健康。

questions.stem: How long does Ben usually brush his teeth?
How long should proper brushing take?
What does the dentist suggest Ben use?
options: An electric brush with a timer.

questions.stem: What do studies confirm about that brush?
options: It removes more of the soft film.

questions.stem: Why does Ben decide to buy one?
options: Because his friend told him to.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Life in the Blue Zones
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: In a few special places, people live longer and more healthily than elsewhere.
These places are known as the Blue Zones.
People there eat lots of vegetables and move their bodies every day.
They also keep a low-stress life with family and friends.
None of their habits is hard, but together they make a big difference.
exercises.translation_cn: 在少数特别的地方,人们比别处活得更久更健康;这些地方被称为蓝区;那里的人吃很多蔬菜、每天活动身体;还和家人朋友过着低压力的生活;他们的习惯都不难,但合在一起作用很大。

questions.stem: What is special about these few places?
options: People live longer and more healthily.

questions.stem: What are these places called?
How often do people there move their bodies?
What kind of life do they keep?
options: A low-stress life with family and friends.

questions.stem: What does the passage say about their habits?
options: They have no effect at all.
Only the rich can follow them.
None is hard, but together they make a big difference.
